title: Bottle O' Fire
description: Throwable Molotovs and Oil Bottles for pyromaniac fun!
body:
Ever thought Minecraft combat could be spiced up with weapons that cause more chaos than damage? Have a secret pyromaniac inside you? You've come to the right place!

This data pack adds a functional Molotov (Called Bottle o' Fire) to the game. These can be crafted and thrown as a potion! Once it lands, it'll send out a random spread of fire in under a second, setting ablaze anything nearby.

Additionally, Splash Oil Bottles can be crafted and thrown to create small oil spills, which will ignite if fire touches them, and slow whatever walks through. Adds to the pyromaniacal fun!

Both are complete with sound effects, which can be turned off by muting "Blocks" in sound settings.

Have fun burning down your friends' houses!
